excludedNativeShaders.name: scene07-sky145-cloud-sphere
excludedNativeShaders.reason: Non-PBR shader has no automatic portable equivalent

warnings: Visible measured-HDR camera sky is nearly white. It differs from the native generated cloud cap and the reference blue/cloud texture; this first physical look is not photographically accepted.
Garden canopy/flower/rock morphology and architectural proportions remain source geometry approximations; no new assets or geometry redesign were integrated.

Native glTF AO modulation and GPU single-pass/culling behavior are not literal optical transport. Actual source vertexColors/alphaTest/opacity flags, UV layers, normals, RGB and matrices remain recorded; physical GI and thin BSDF replace additive leaf approximations.
Exact timber metric formula/phase is ported with Float32 CPU math; GPU sin/FMA phase and camera color curves are not pixel-equivalent.

materialTransfer.timberUV: Source longest-axis member metres, absolute source normal axis and per-instance length/translation phase. All original UV sets retained separately; derived metric UVs are the shader sampling chart.
materialTransfer.timberPhasePrecision: CPU NumPy Float32 dot/sin/fract follows the original GLSL equation; GPU transcendental/FMA rounding is not asserted pixel-identical.
materialTransfer.timberReflectanceBound: Original scan times original source RGB gains, vertex RGB if enabled and exact instance RGB. Effective timber RGB only clipped to[0,.98] for physical reflectance. Original gains retained in receipt.
materialTransfer.roughness: Exact native source clamp(.36+.72*mapG*.9,.42,.94) for all five scanned-timber materials. Source neutral stone and foreground clayState/glaze equations ported.
materialTransfer.missingGenericExporterFields: Original foreground clearcoat weight/roughness/normal maps are read from verified original source paths; no duplicate PNG files. Original UV1/color_1/clayState attributes retained.
materialTransfer.thinTransport: Energy-conserving source-pigment Principled/Translucent mix with actual occlusion; no native view-facing additive leaf term. Rice paper38%, momiji28%, needles18%, other leaves25%.
limits: Source custom GLSL fog, AO and planar capture do not equal physical transport.
glTF AO map modulation is replaced by physical GI; original UV1 is preserved.
ACESFilmic native and physical AgX are different camera curves.

sourceGeometryTransfer.rank2Policy: Never excluded for determinant zero. All indexed faces retained, including legitimate rank2 planes; cofactor/geometric normals for singular affine transforms. Degenerate source faces remain indices and have no ray area.
sourceGeometryTransfer.UVBasisConvention: Native texture transform retained for tangent basis; file bitmap flip convention applied to image sampling only.

waterReplacement.source: Exact canonical pondOutline/ShapeGeometry60 positions, indices, UV and world matrix reproduced from verified sourcemain.js. No replacement pond/architecture geometry.

physicalLighting.scope: Same original independently licensed source HDRI; explicit world-direction port. Original source generated camera-only cloud cap omitted for this independent physical review. No architecture or garden plate.

renderSettings.physicalSourceCamera: Original unchanged source pose/FOV; finite lens foreground DOF is an explicit renderer adaptation.

blend.reason: No duplicate source PNG/EXR bytes; original verified asset and one export tree remain linked.

findings: Occupied upper hall and carved relief retain actual source depth. Physical surface shading produces coherent timber grain and contact/recess shadows.
Original foreground glaze maps and clayState wear are retained; physical highlights/reflections differ from native capture.
Measured Qwantani camera sky is too pale/white for the supplied reference; original generated cloud cap is deliberately omitted from this independent physical look.
Foliage cutout alpha now applies around the complete physical BSDF, preserving transparent atlas borders.
Wood/frame repetition and garden morphology still read CG. No photographic match, final film or native pixel equivalence is claimed.
